family.description: HCP is a family of proteins which are expressed in up to 1000 copies in Gram-negative bacteria. Together these copies aggregate into a needle-like shaft or tube that will penetrate other bacteria via a puncturing protein attached to its head [[cite:PUB00075434]] being part of the type VI secretion system [[cite:PUB00155386],[cite:PUB00054686]]. Initially Hcp forms a hexameric structure with a central channel of 40 Angstroms. These hexamers pile up one on top of each other forming nanotubes resembling the gp19 tail phage tube [[cite:PUB00034462]].
family.name: Type VI secretion system effector, Hcp
